name: CILogon / Globus Auth (OSP) OpenID Connect Client
description: A pluggable client implementation for the OpenID Connect One Science Place(OSP) Client.
project_description: CILogon / Globus Auth (OSP) extends the contributed OpenID Connect module with two ready-made OIDC client plugins for the research-computing identity providers CILogon (plugin id ospclscigw) and Globus Auth (plugin id ospgascigw), pre-seeded with each provider's authorize/token/userinfo endpoints and default scopes. It adds a settings page for customizing the per-client login button text and contextual help, an optional Key-module integration for the client secret, Globus-specific authorize parameters (session_required_policies, session_required_single_domain, session_message) for domain-restricted login, a Connected Accounts UI that shows the human-readable identity-provider name, optional auto-assignment of non-admin roles to newly provisioned SSO accounts, an option to hide the public registration link, and a localized plain logout flow that also rewrites the Globus web-logout round trip so users return to the site.
